chapter.verse: Topa ka bel hi; bangci-in ka tungah, “Vasa leeng bangin mual tungah tai-in,
bang hang hiam cih leh, en in, migilote in, khuamial sung pan lungsim thutangte kap dingin a thalkhau uh-ah thaltang bulhin a thal uh keek hi;
bulpite kisusia leh, midikte in bang cih thei nawn ding hiam?” nong ci thei diam?
Topa in ama biakinn siangtho sungah om a, Topa ’ tokhom in vantungah om hi; a mit-in en a, a mit tawh mihing’ tate entel hi.
Topa in midikte leh migilote en tel a, a ngongtat nuam mi a lungsim in mudah hi.
Migilote tungah amah in mei-am leh kat zusak ding a, amau ngah ding hai in huih sa mahmah hi ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa dik a, dik gamtatna deih hi; thutang mi in ama mai mu ding hi.
